invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new Array, so result should not be null.
A newly created Array will have size at least 0.
At most one AssetDescriptor is added, so result can contain at most one element.
If an atlas file handle is found, 1 descriptor is added; otherwise, the result is empty.
If the result contains any element, that element (the AssetDescriptor) is non-null.
